test_title: PYST 25: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight people, D, E, M, P, T, W, Y and Z are sitting in a straight line, facing north. D sits third from the left end of the line. Only one person sits between D and Z. P sits third to the right of Z. Only two people sit between P and W. E sits to the immediate right of Y. M does not sit at any of the extreme ends of the line. What is the position of T from the right end of the line?
solution:
As per the given information, the sitting arrangement is as:

1.D sits third from the left end of the line.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f1bb8ff3b5bffb24e9854bfc974bf95e8e8a206481c69bfff4e9b4452aacae2.png] 

2. Only one person sits between D and Z.

**Case 1:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f035ded7a69b3cc435480c4c5ae913413b9aba58dfc1086606f1fb5244406dba.png] 

**Case 2:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7dae9fbf3d065578ffa9a749b3038f730eac38f8b259a670a7ae2cc9bfcaf1b.png] 

3. P sits third to the right of Z.

**Case 1:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b93fe7ddd2e3727917c278779a32bc6c47aae29dcb740de01bc338336b694409.png] 

**Case 2:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72a764d877c60f44380bc91109bd5cb4735b1506669ffe9496a154d2138b1e0a.png] 

4. Only two people sit between P and W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86436208d74b79571ad6ec3a75e2c9af2b6bfc0a6ccdec889dab3f5f6737469f.png] 

5. E sits to the immediate right of Y. and M does not sit at any of the extreme ends of the line.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0667a0ffcf33023d8e216e813dd7fb20adcd17cc3dc11e2d40c06c93c4fc86e3.png] 

Here, T is** first** from the right end.

Hence, the correct answer is "First".
